subject: general
question: Rajan sold an article to Shyam at a profit of 20%, Shyam sold it to Mohan at a loss of 10%, while Mohan sold it to Ratan at a profit of 12.5%. If Ratan purchased the article for Rs. 1,215, then at what price did Rajan purchase it?
solution:
Given:

Rajan sold an article to Shyam at a profit of 20%, Shyam sold it to Mohan at a loss of 10%, while Mohan sold it to Ratan at a profit of 12.5%.

Ratan purchased the article for Rs. 1,215.

Concept used:

1. Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 + Gain%)

2. Selling Price = Cost Price × (1 - Loss%)

Calculation:

Cost price occurred to Mohan = 1215/(1 + 12.5%) = Rs. 1080

Cost price occurred to Shyam = 1080/(1 - 10%) = Rs. 1200

Cost price occurred to Ratan = 1200/(1 + 20%) = Rs. 1000

∴ Rajan purchased it at Rs. 1000.
